QuestionStmt.S: Find the mass of sodium carbonate in grams to form 100 ml 0.1 M solution in water? (Molar mass of Na$_2$CO$_3$ = 106 g/mol)

Solution.S:
Molarity is given by $M = \frac{\text{moles of solute}}{\text{volume of solution in litres}}$.

Here, $M = 0.1$ M and volume = $100$ mL = $0.1$ L.

So, moles of Na$_2$CO$_3$ = $M \times V = 0.1 \times 0.1 = 0.01$ mol.

Mass = moles $\times$ molar mass = $0.01 \times 106 = 1.06$ g.

Final Answer: $$\boxed{1.06 \text{ g}}$$

Hence, the correct option is A.
